title: Physics-Informed Stochastic Configuration Machine: A Backpropagation-Free Neural Network with Fast Training for Nonlinear Differential Equations
abstract: arXiv:2608.26549v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a transformative paradigm for solving complex differential equations, their reliance on backpropagation-based gradient descent and automatic differentiation (AD) imposes significant computational bottlenecks and severe non-convex optimization challenges. To overcome these fundamental limitations, we propose the Physics-Informed Stochastic Configuration Machine (PI-SCM), a novel backpropagation-free framework for both forward and inverse problems in differential equations. The core mathematical contribution lies in the analytical evaluation of local Jacobians for nonlinear differential operators, which facilitates a linearized representation of the physical loss and projects it into a unified, linearized algebraic subspace. This reformulation allows for the explicit determination of optimal network weights via a sequence of generalized linear least squares solvers, effective

translated_title: 物理信息随机配置机：一种免反向传播、快速训练的非线性微分方程神经网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26549v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管物理信息神经网络（PINNs）已成为求解复杂微分方程的变革性范式，但其对基于反向传播的梯度下降和自动微分（AD）的依赖，带来了显著的计算瓶颈和严重的非凸优化挑战。为克服这些根本性限制，我们提出了物理信息随机配置机（PI-SCM），这是一种新颖的免反向传播框架，适用于微分方程的正向和逆向问题。核心数学贡献在于对非线性微分算子的局部雅可比矩阵进行解析评估，这有助于将物理损失线性化表示，并将其投影到统一的线性化代数子空间中。这种重构使得通过一系列广义线性最小二乘求解器显式确定最优网络权重成为可能，有效...
tldr: 提出了一种免反向传播的物理信息随机配置机（PI-SCM），通过解析评估局部雅可比矩阵将物理损失线性化，并利用广义线性最小二乘求解器显式确定网络权重，从而显著加速非线性微分方程求解并规避非凸优化难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a backpropagation-free Physics-Informed Stochastic Configuration Machine (PI-SCM) that linearizes the physical loss via analytical local Jacobians and explicitly determines network weights using generalized linear least squares solvers, significantly accelerating nonlinear differential equation solving and avoiding non-convex optimization challenges.
